items.title: Mona Hinton interviewed by Milt Fillius and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: Doc was in the band, Doc had left the band when I was there because Dizzy was there.

ctx.x: Wasn’t Doc Cheatham in that band too?
